purpose: Decide whether the five-edge defensive baseline justifies active complexity versus passive US equities.

benchmark.valuation: adjusted total-return multiplier applied to raw entry notional

success_contract.return_pass: active CAGR strictly exceeds benchmark CAGR
success_contract.risk_adjusted_pass: active CAGR is at least 75% of benchmark CAGR and active drawdown is at most 60% of benchmark drawdown

limitations: SPY is a US-equity benchmark, not yet the final global UCITS benchmark for a Spanish investor.
Adjusted data is used only for the total-return path; raw price determines whole-share affordability.
No benchmark may be substituted after observing the result to manufacture a pass.
